title: The PayPal Express Checkout plugin has been deprecated
description:
Hi there,



We’re writing to let you know that, due to the author’s request, the PayPal Express Checkout plugin was deprecated on July 9, 2024.



**What does this mean for you?**



The plugin is no longer available for download. As it looks like you may have been using it, we wanted to inform you that as of July 29th, if the plugin is:

- **Disabled on your site**, it’ll be removed
- **Enabled on your site,** it’ll be left in place, but it won’t be possible to automatically or manually update it going forward

If you’re looking for an alternative, we’d suggest using the WooCommerce PayPal Payments plugin.



Thanks for your time,



The WordPress.com Team



P.S. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to get in touch by replying directly to this email.
